# Vendored third-party assets

- `echarts.min.js` — [Apache ECharts](https://echarts.apache.org/) **v5.6.0**,
  licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (license header embedded at the top of the file).
  Vendored so the dashboard works out of the box with **no `npm install` step**.
- `samples/` (repository root) contains the reference metric exports provided with the
  test brief, used by `npm run validate` to verify metric correctness.
